my.color.list = list()
show_palette = function(q,qname=''){
  #print(qname)
  if(qname !=''){
    #print("working")
    my.color.list[[qname]] <<- q #this is how you change global variable
    #print(paste("length(my.color.list)=",length(my.color.list)))
  }
  
  x = seq_along(q)
  y = rep(1,length(q))
  d = data.frame(x = x, y = y)
  par(mar=c(1,1,1,1))
  barplot(y~x,d,col = q,border = NA,space = 0,cex.names=0.5,xlab = "",yaxt='n',ylab = "",xaxt='n',main = qname)
}

emulate ggplot2’s default color palette

gg_color_hue <- function(n) {
  hues = seq(15, 375, length = n + 1)
  hcl(h = hues, l = 65, c = 100)[1:n]
}

nn = seq(2,10)
for(n in nn){
  q = gg_color_hue(n)
  show_palette(q,qname = paste("gg_hue",n,sep = "_"))
}

#there lut files are not standard, some have 16 bytes 
#
read_ij_lut = function(file.name){
  sz =file.info(file.name)$size
  if(sz == 768){
    con = file(file.name,"rb")
    #con = file("/Users/xx/Desktop/notes/colorcard/idl_color/color13.lut","rb")
    z = readBin(con,"integer",256*3,size = 1,signed = F)
    close(con)
    u = matrix(z,nrow=256)
  }
  
  if(sz == 800){
    con = file(file.name,"rb")
    z = readBin(con,"integer",n = 8) #for theose have size of 800bytes
    z = readBin(con,"integer",256*3,size = 1,signed = F)
    close(con)
    u = matrix(z,nrow=256)
  }

  if(sz > 800){
    u <- read.table(file.name,header = F)
    u = u[complete.cases(u),]
    dz = dim(u)
    if(dz[1] > 256){
      #has header
      u = u[-1,]
    }
    if(dz[2] > 3){
      #has index
      u = u[,-1]
    }
  }
  q = apply(u,1,function(x) rgb(x[1],x[2],x[3],maxColorValue=255))
  return(q)
}


read_zeiss_lut = function(file.name){
  con = file(file.name,"rb")
  #con = file("zen_Palettes/004_Magenta.lut","rb")
  #con = file("zen_Palettes/031_Rainbow.lut","rb")
  #con = file("zen_Palettes/032_Rainbow2.lut","rb")
  
  p = seek(con,0)
  z = readBin(con,"character") #this should read "CZ - LSM510 Color Palette , Version 1.00"
  p = seek(con,41)
  l = readBin(con,"integer",1,size = 4)
  z = readBin(con,"character") #this gives the name of the palette
  offset = 46+l
  p = seek(con,offset)
  
  r = readBin(con,"integer",256*16,size = 2,signed = F)
  p = seek(con,offset+4096*2)
  g = readBin(con,"integer",256*16,size = 2,signed = F)
  p = seek(con,offset+4096*4)
  b = readBin(con,"integer",256*16,size = 2,signed = F)
  
  close(con)
  
  r = r[seq(1,4096,16)]
  g = g[seq(1,4096,16)]
  b = b[seq(1,4096,16)]
  
  uz = matrix(c(r,g,b),nrow = 256)
  u = apply(uz,2,function(x) {y = round(x/16); ifelse(y==256,255,y)})
  
  # plot(u[,1],col="red",type = "l",ylim=c(0,255))
  # lines(u[,2],col="green")
  # lines(u[,3],col="blue")
  
  q = apply(u,1,function(x) rgb(x[1],x[2],x[3],maxColorValue=255))
}

read_ms_xml_lut=function(file){
  x = read_xml(file)
  srgb_nodes <- xml_find_all(x, ".//a:srgbClr")
  color_values <- xml_attr(srgb_nodes, "val")
  parent_names <- xml_name(xml_parent(srgb_nodes))
  q = paste0("#",color_values)
  names(q)=parent_names
  
  #the first two is not interesting anyway
  # srgb_nodes <- xml_find_all(x, ".//a:sysClr")
  # color_values <- xml_attr(srgb_nodes, "lastClr")
  # parent_names <- xml_name(xml_parent(srgb_nodes))
  # q0 = paste0("#",color_values)
  # names(q0)=parent_names
  # q = c(q0,q)
  
  return(q)
}

h.df = sprintf("%02X",seq(0,255))
comp_hex = function(hex_color,book = h.df){
  rgb = colorspace::hex2RGB(hex_color)
  c_rgb = 1+as.vector(255*(1- rgb@coords))
  #I don't know why, `sprintf("%X",c_rgb[1]` doesn't work
  c_hex = paste0("#",h.df[c_rgb[1]],h.df[c_rgb[2]],h.df[c_rgb[3]])
  #c_hex = colorspace::hex(1- rgb@coords)
  return(c_hex)
}

msc.df$id = c(files,"office")
msc.g = msc.df %>% pivot_longer(-id,names_to = "type",values_to = "hex") %>%
          mutate(hex.f = factor(hex),c_hex = map_chr(hex,~comp_hex(.x)),c_hex.f = factor(c_hex))
msc.g$type = factor(msc.g$type,levels = names(msc.df)[1:10])
p = msc.g %>% ggplot(aes(x = type, y = sub(".xml","", id)))+
          geom_tile(aes(fill=hex.f),color = "black")+
          geom_text(aes(label=hex.f,color = c_hex.f))+
          scale_fill_manual(values = levels(msc.g$hex.f))+
          scale_color_manual(values = levels(msc.g$c_hex.f))+
        theme_classic()+ 
        scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult =0),position = "top")+ 
        scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult =0))+
        theme(legend.position = "none",text = element_text(size = 20))+
        xlab("")+ylab("")+ggtitle("MS Office Color Themes")
print(p)
